how_to_run: See README.md. Judge each case with an LLM or a human against expect/reject; strings are concepts, not literal matches.

cases.prompt: My dropdown menu feels cheap when it opens. Here's the CSS: opacity 0 to 1 and scale(0) to 1 over 600ms ease-in, transform-origin center.
cases.notes: The canonical four-part fix. A good answer rewrites the CSS, not just names the rules.

cases.prompt: Review the motion in src/components. I want to know what feels off and the exact changes to make.
expect: reads the transition/animate/spring/drag code before advising
reports findings as rule N: before -> after with a reason
does not rewrite motion that already follows the rules
reject: gives generic advice without reading the code
rewrites everything to a single duration
cases.notes: Tool use is a bonus: scripts/audit-motion.mjs catches the mechanical violations.

cases.prompt: When the user saves, the button label changes from Save to Saved. Make the confirmation feel more noticeable without a toast.

expect.contains: one pulse in addition to the label change

expect: keeps the label change for accessibility
reject: replaces the label with motion only

cases.prompt: The switch knob slides rigidly across the track and feels like a sticker. Make it feel physical.

expect.contains: about 12% stretch along travel with area preserved

reject: leaves the stretch on at rest
cases.notes: A good answer gives scaleX 1.12 / scaleY 0.89 and a code sample.

cases.prompt: Clicking a card opens a detail view. Right now the card disappears and the detail page appears on a new route. How should this animate?

expect.contains: return trip exits toward the card

cases.notes: May mention FLIP or View Transitions as alternatives.

cases.prompt: The copy icon becomes a check instantly. Make it feel smooth.
cases.notes: Should include popLayout or absolute stacking to avoid layout shift.

cases.prompt: Dragging our sheet feels laggy. There's a CSS transition on transform and the sheet stops dead at the edge.

expect.contains: 1:1 pointer tracking while held; no transition

cases.notes: May reference dragElastic or the rubberBand formula.

cases.prompt: Switching tabs flickers: the old content fades out, there's a beat of empty space, then the new content fades in. It also looks muddy halfway through.

expect.contains: mask or clip instead of crossfading text

expect: identifies mode=wait or sequential fades as the cause
cases.notes: The two symptoms have two different fixes; a strong answer names both.

cases.prompt: Animate the search results in with a cascade. There are 30 rows.

expect.contains: cap the staggered rows at about 8-10

cases.notes: The cap is the differentiator; a naive answer staggers everything.

cases.prompt: Give me the motion spec for a settings modal: backdrop, panel, open and close.

expect.contains: backdrop and panel animate together, no blank frame

reject: backdrop fades out before the panel
cases.notes: May include focus management and reduced motion.

cases.prompt: Our marketing site has parallax, a spinning hero badge and auto-playing cards. Is that okay for accessibility?
expect: flags vestibular risk from parallax, spin and autoplay
requires prefers-reduced-motion support and a pause for autoplay
keeps opacity/colour feedback in the reduced-motion branch
reject: says motion is purely aesthetic and safe
removes all feedback under reduced motion
cases.notes: Should recommend a per-effect branch, not only a global 1ms reset.

cases.prompt: Add an index on users.email and write the migration.
expect: answers the database task without loading motion guidance

cases.prompt: Write a 600-word blog post about the history of animation.
expect: writes the post without applying UI motion rules
reject: turns the post into a UI motion checklist
cases.notes: Writing about animation is not UI motion implementation.

cases.prompt: This text fails contrast on the grey background. Fix the colours.
